PROJECT // 001

ASSASSIN'S CREED
INDEPENDENCE

NON-COMMERCIAL FAN PROJECT • EDUCATIONAL & PORTFOLIO PURPOSES • NOT AFFILIATED WITH UBISOFT

Assassin's Creed: Independence is a fan-made, story-driven, open-world stealth action-adventure game set in British India during the late 1930s. Experience the struggle between the Assassins and the Templars through the eyes of Serma Hembram, known within the Brotherhood as the Ghost Assassin.

03 // STORY

THE WORLD OF INDEPENDENCE

A MEMORY OF
1939 BENGAL.

Every rooftop hides a secret. Every shadow tells a story.

SERMA HEMBRAM

After years away from his homeland, Serma returns to Medinipur, Bengal. A calm and highly skilled Assassin, he becomes drawn into a conspiracy threatening the city.

THE CONSPIRACY

Mysterious disappearances, political unrest and the rise of respected philanthropist Debendra Mukherjee conceal a dangerous Templar conspiracy.

THE BROTHERHOOD

Alongside his sister Shristi Hembram, the Lady Assassin of Bengal, his lifelong friend Sagar Sen and trusted allies, Serma searches for the truth.

MEDINIPUR

Explore a historically inspired Bengal brought to life through a blend of real events and original fiction.
